focus: Decompiler optimization pass system, explicit stage hook points, and feedback loops between stages that re-trigger earlier passes when later-stage decisions (e.g., structuring success/failure) invalidate prior analyses.

pipeline.name: AIL Graph Creation
pipeline.description: Convert VEX IR to AIL (Angr IL), fix switch cases, rewrite ITEs, insert labels. Produces initial AIL graph.

pipeline.name: AFTER_AIL_GRAPH_CREATION Optimization Passes
pipeline.description: Early graph-wide simplifications on fresh AIL. Currently runs SwitchDefaultCaseDuplicator and SwitchReusedEntryRewriter to undo compiler switch case reuse optimizations.
pipeline.outputs: Simplified AIL graph with modified switch structure
substeps: SwitchDefaultCaseDuplicator: duplicate default-case nodes to undo compiler deduplication
SwitchReusedEntryRewriter: convert switch-case entry nodes with multiple predecessors to gotos

pipeline.name: Indirect Jump/Tail Call Analysis
pipeline.description: Replace single-target indirect jumps with direct calls; convert tail calls.
pipeline.outputs: AIL graph with normalized jump/call targets

pipeline.name: BEFORE_SSA_LEVEL0_TRANSFORMATION Passes
pipeline.description: Run X86GccGetPcSimplifier to simplify getpc() on x86 before SSA level 0.

pipeline.name: SSA Level 0 Transformation
pipeline.description: Convert to SSA with tmps (temporary variables) but not stack vars. Phi functions introduced for variable convergence points.
pipeline.outputs: SSA-form AIL graph with Phi expressions

pipeline.name: AFTER_SINGLE_BLOCK_SIMPLIFICATION Passes
pipeline.description: Run simplifications after single-block AIL simplification: RegisterSaveAreaSimplifier, ConditionConstantPropagation, ConstantDereferencesSimplifier, WinStackCanarySimplifier. These operate block-by-block.
pipeline.inputs: AIL blocks with SSA level 0 form

pipeline.name: BEFORE_SSA_LEVEL1_TRANSFORMATION Passes
pipeline.description: Simplify inlined string operations (memcpy, memset, strcpy, wcscpy, string transformations) before stack-var SSA.
pipeline.outputs: Simplified AIL graph with inlined function patterns replaced

pipeline.name: SSA Level 1 Transformation
pipeline.description: Convert to full SSA with both tmps and stack vars. More aggressive phi/convergence handling.
pipeline.outputs: Full SSA-form AIL graph with stack var phi expressions

pipeline.name: AFTER_SSA_LEVEL1_TRANSFORMATION Passes
pipeline.description: Late inlined function simplifications that depend on full SSA form: InlinedMemcpySimplifierLate, InlinedMemsetSimplifierLate, InlinedStrcpySimplifierLate, InlinedWcscpySimplifierLate.

pipeline.name: Reaching Definitions Analysis
pipeline.description: Compute reaching definition information for use in constant propagation and other data-flow-dependent optimizations.

pipeline.name: AFTER_MAKING_CALLSITES Passes
pipeline.description: After call sites are normalized: CallStatementRewriter, RegisterSaveAreaSimplifierAdvanced.

pipeline.name: AFTER_GLOBAL_SIMPLIFICATION Passes
pipeline.description: Heavy lifting before region identification. Multiple de-optimization passes that revert compiler optimizations to improve decompilability: ReturnDuplicatorHigh, ITERegionConverter, ITEExprConverter, ExprOpSwapper, ConstantDereferencesSimplifier, DivSimplifier, ModSimplifier, BasePointerSaveSimplifier, RetAddrSaveSimplifier, MipsGpSettingSimplifier, StackCanarySimplifier, InlinedStrlenSimplifier, CodeMotionOptimization, DetermineLoadSizes, etc. These edit the AIL graph in semantically-altering ways.
pipeline.outputs: De-optimized AIL graph with restored control flow structure
substeps: ReturnDuplicatorHigh: duplicate return-only blocks to break up gotos
ITERegionConverter/ITEExprConverter: convert if-then-else regions to ternary expressions
ExprOpSwapper: swap binary operator operands as requested
Various simplifiers: undo compiler-specific optimizations (canary checks, register saves, etc.)

pipeline.name: BEFORE_VARIABLE_RECOVERY Passes
pipeline.description: Last chance to simplify before variable recovery. EagerStdStringConcatenationPass, EagerStdStringEvalPass, StaticVVarRewriter. These work on already-SSA code.

pipeline.name: Delay Graph Updates Decision
pipeline.description: Check if any DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION passes exist. If yes, defer graph updates from RegionIdentifier to allow those passes to run iteratively.

pipeline.name: Region Identification (First Pass)
pipeline.description: Recover high-level regions (loops, if-else chains, etc.) using Phoenix structuring algorithm schema matching. May create artificial blocks for loop successors without updating the AIL graph topology if update_graph=False.
pipeline.outputs: RegionIdentifier with recovered region tree and goto analysis

pipeline.name: BEFORE_REGION_IDENTIFICATION Passes
pipeline.description: Simplifications that must complete before region identification starts. Currently DeadblockRemover removes blocks with unsatisfiable conditions.

pipeline.name: DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION Passes (Structuring Loop)
pipeline.description: De-optimization passes that require iterative structuring: DuplicationReverter (ISM), CrossJumpReverter (ISC), ConstPropOptReverter, ReturnDuplicatorLow, ReturnDeduplicator, LoweredSwitchSimplifier (for certain structurers). These run inside a fixed-point loop with re-RegionIdentification after each graph edit.
pipeline.outputs: De-optimized AIL graph, updated RegionIdentifier (via fixed-point iteration)
substeps: - Run pass, check for graph changes
- Continue until fixed point or max iterations
- Validate graph remains structurable (or recover previous version)
- Check goto count does not increase (prevent_new_gotos constraint)
- Check relative quality metrics (loop/goto structure quality)

pipeline.name: AFTER_VARIABLE_RECOVERY Passes
pipeline.description: Post-variable-recovery optimizations. Currently TagSlicer removes unmarked statements when desired_variables are specified.

pipeline.name: RecursiveStructurer (SAILR/Phoenix)
pipeline.description: Perform structuring of regions into control flow abstractions (loops, if-else, switch statements) using recursive schema matching (SAILR by default).

pipeline.name: RegionSimplifier
pipeline.description: Simplify regions: remove phi expressions, simplify gotos, apply structuring artifacts.
pipeline.outputs: Simplified sequence node, goto manager with goto information

pipeline.name: AFTER_STRUCTURING Passes
pipeline.description: Post-structuring optimizations on sequence nodes: FlipBooleanCmp, ExprOpSwapper, PostStructuringPeepholeOptimizationPass. These work on high-level structured IR.
substeps: FlipBooleanCmp: flip small boolean conditions to simplify else blocks
PostStructuringPeepholeOptimization: apply expression/statement-level peephole optimizations on structured code

pipeline.name: Code Generation
pipeline.description: Generate C/Rust pseudocode from optimized sequence node tree.
pipeline.inputs: Sequence node tree, function signature, variable information
pipeline.outputs: CStructuredCodeGenerator or RustStructuredCodeGenerator with text property

feedback_loops.name: Graph Edit Triggers RegionIdentifier Re-run
feedback_loops.trigger: Any DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass modifies the AIL graph (out_graph is not None)
feedback_loops.mechanism: decompiler.py:645-657 calls _recover_regions() after graph change detected; StructuringOptimizationPass._fixed_point_analyze() iterates up to max_opt_iters times

feedback_loops.name: Graph Restructurability Failure Recovery
feedback_loops.trigger: RegionIdentifier or structuring fails to produce a valid structurable graph after optimization
feedback_loops.mechanism: StructuringOptimizationPass._fixed_point_analyze() catches structurability failure, restores self._prev_graph if recover_structure_fails=True, sets out_graph=None

feedback_loops.name: Structuring Quality Rejection
feedback_loops.trigger: must_improve_rel_quality check fails: optimization traded 'good' control structures (for loops) for 'bad' ones (while/do-while), or increased goto complexity
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Reject optimization (discard out_graph), retry next pass
feedback_loops.mechanism: StructuringOptimizationPass.analyze() calls _improves_relative_quality() which examines ControlFlowStructureCounter metrics (loop types, goto counts); returns False causes out_graph=None

feedback_loops.name: Goto Count Violation Recovery
feedback_loops.trigger: DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass violates prevent_new_gotos or strictly_less_gotos constraints
feedback_loops.mechanism: StructuringOptimizationPass.analyze() checks _get_new_gotos() count against _initial_gotos, sets out_graph=None if constraint violated

feedback_loops.name: Block Simplifier Uses Cached Analysis Results
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Does not rewind; uses cached reaching definitions and propagation results to avoid recomputation
feedback_loops.mechanism: optimization_pass.py:361-384 caches reaching definitions and propagator results per block; BlockCache named tuple stores (rd, prop); cache checked/updated on each block simplification pass

feedback_loops.name: SSA Form De-phi / Variable Mapping
feedback_loops.trigger: After structuring and before final code generation, phi expressions must be removed and SSA form normalized
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Applies dephication mapping computed during structuring (one-pass transformation, not a rewind)
feedback_loops.mechanism: decompiler.py:461 calls transform_seqnode_from_ssa() which rewrites all phi references using dephi mapping computed earlier in clinic

feedback_loops.name: Preset-Specific Pass Ordering Affects Results
feedback_loops.trigger: User selects 'fast', 'full', 'basic', or 'malware' preset; different presets have different pass orderings and subsets
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Entire optimization pipeline re-runs with different pass set; changes which optimizations are applied and in what order
feedback_loops.mechanism: decompiler.py:118-130 selects preset, calls preset.get_optimization_passes(); preset.py:17-37 filters passes by ARCHES/PLATFORMS

feedback_loops.name: Custom Pass Registration Modifies Global State
feedback_loops.trigger: Third party calls register_optimization_pass(OptPassClass, presets=['fast']) at runtime
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Pass is added to ALL_OPTIMIZATION_PASSES and optionally to chosen presets; affects all future decompilations using that preset
feedback_loops.mechanism: optimization_passes/__init__.py:129-139 appends pass to list and inserts into preset.opt_passes

decision_points.name: Delay Graph Updates Flag
decision_points.decision: Are any DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION passes registered? If yes, defer graph topology updates from RegionIdentifier. If no, update immediately.
decision_points.alternatives: Updating immediately allows simpler control flow but prevents iterative structuring optimizations. Deferring allows SAILR de-optimizations to run but requires extra RegionIdentifier re-runs.
decision_points.current_override: Dynamically computed from self._optimization_passes list; can be overridden by user via preset selection or custom optimization_passes parameter

decision_points.name: Preset Selection
decision_points.decision: Which preset to use: 'fast', 'full', 'basic', 'malware', or custom optimization_passes list?
decision_points.alternatives: fast: enables 38 passes including return duplicators and de-optimization reversers. full: 42 passes including aggressive duplication/cross-jump reversions. basic: 21 passes, minimal de-optimization. malware: tuned for obfuscated code.
decision_points.current_override: preset parameter (str or DecompilationPreset), defaults to 'fast'. User can also pass optimization_passes list directly.

decision_points.name: Graph Structurability Assertion Behavior
decision_points.decision: On structuring failure, should we recover the previous graph (recover_structure_fails=True) or discard changes (False)?
decision_points.alternatives: True: conservative, keeps decompilation working even if optimization failed. False: aggressive, may result in unparseable code but forces optimization to succeed or abort.
decision_points.current_override: recover_structure_fails parameter in StructuringOptimizationPass.__init__, passed by individual pass subclasses (e.g., DuplicationReverter sets True)

decision_points.name: Relative Quality Improvement Check
decision_points.decision: Did this optimization improve the control flow structure quality relative to the initial state? Check via heuristics: loop type degradation, goto complexity increase.
decision_points.alternatives: If must_improve_rel_quality=True (default for SAILR passes), reject optimization if it trades for-loops for while-loops or increases backward gotos. If False, accept any structurable graph.
decision_points.current_override: must_improve_rel_quality parameter in StructuringOptimizationPass.__init__; defaults to True for safety

decision_points.name: Peephole Optimization Suite Selection
decision_points.decision: Which peephole optimizations to run? Default to ALL_PEEPHOLE_OPTS (split into EXPR_OPTS, STMT_OPTS, MULTI_STMT_OPTS) or user-provided subset?
decision_points.alternatives: Custom peephole_optimizations list allows fine-grained control over expression/statement rewrites. Default set includes ~60+ optimizations (arithmetic simplification, bit manipulation, type conversions, string operations).
decision_points.current_override: peephole_optimizations parameter passed through OptimizationPass and Clinic; None defaults to ALL_PEEPHOLE_OPTS

decision_points.name: Fixed-Point Iteration Limit
decision_points.decision: How many times should we re-structure after each DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass graph edit? Default max_opt_iters=1 for most passes, 5 for DuplicationReverter.
decision_points.alternatives: Higher limits allow more aggressive de-optimization but increase compile time. Lower limits trade thoroughness for speed.
decision_points.current_override: max_opt_iters parameter in StructuringOptimizationPass.__init__; each SAILR pass subclass specifies its own value

decision_points.name: Block Caching Strategy for Simplification
decision_points.decision: Should we cache reaching definitions and propagation results across block simplifications to avoid recomputation?
decision_points.alternatives: With cache: faster but may miss optimizations if analysis results become stale. Without cache: slower but always up-to-date.
decision_points.current_override: cache parameter can be passed to _simplify_block; if None, no caching

decision_points.name: Goto Requirements Assertion
decision_points.decision: If require_gotos=True, should we skip the optimization if there are no gotos in the initial graph? (Indicates pass is only useful for goto-heavy code.)
decision_points.alternatives: If True, pass skips when no gotos found. If False, pass always runs.
decision_points.current_override: require_gotos parameter; DuplicationReverter and CrossJumpReverter set True

intervention_surfaces.name: OptimizationPassStage Enum Hook Points
intervention_surfaces.description: Each OptimizationPass subclass declares STAGE = OptimizationPassStage.AFTER_AIL_GRAPH_CREATION (or other stage). This is the fundamental hook point mechanism.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Entire pipeline: determines when pass runs relative to global simplifications, SSA transformations, region identification, and structuring.

intervention_surfaces.name: register_optimization_pass() API
intervention_surfaces.description: Third-party code can call register_optimization_pass(MyOptPassClass, presets=['fast']) to dynamically add a custom optimization pass to the global ALL_OPTIMIZATION_PASSES list and optionally inject it into specified presets.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Global pass registry and preset configuration; affects all future decompilations.

intervention_surfaces.name: Preset System
intervention_surfaces.description: Four built-in presets define which passes run: 'fast' (38 passes), 'full' (42 passes, most aggressive), 'basic' (21 passes, minimal de-optimization), 'malware' (tuned for obfuscation). User selects via preset parameter.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Which passes run and their order; changes the entire decompilation output.

intervention_surfaces.name: Custom optimization_passes Parameter
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler.__init__ accepts optimization_passes list directly, bypassing preset system. Allows fine-grained control over pass ordering and selection.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Overrides preset selection; allows per-decompilation pass customization.

intervention_surfaces.name: peephole_optimizations Parameter
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler and all OptimizationPass classes accept peephole_optimizations iterable. If None, defaults to ALL_PEEPHOLE_OPTS (60+ optimizations). User can provide subset to focus optimization.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Block and expression simplification; affects both AFTER_*_BLOCK and AFTER_STRUCTURING passes.

intervention_surfaces.name: StructuringOptimizationPass Heuristic Parameters
intervention_surfaces.description: SAILR de-optimization passes accept parameters controlling behavior: prevent_new_gotos, strictly_less_gotos, recover_structure_fails, must_improve_rel_quality, max_opt_iters, require_gotos. These are set per-pass class.
intervention_surfaces.affects: When DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION passes accept/reject changes; controls balance between aggressiveness and safety.

intervention_surfaces.name: Force Loop Single Exit / Loop Refinement Flags
intervention_surfaces.description: OptimizationPass constructor accepts force_loop_single_exit, refine_loops_with_single_successor, complete_successors. These control how RegionIdentifier handles loop boundaries.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Loop recovery; affects which loops are identified and how they're structured.

intervention_surfaces.name: Cache System (BlockCache)
intervention_surfaces.description: OptimizationPass._simplify_block accepts cache dict that stores reaching definitions and propagation results. User can pre-populate cache or let it auto-populate.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Block simplification performance and correctness; stale cache leads to missed optimizations.

intervention_surfaces.name: Static VVar / Buffer Annotations
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler accepts static_vvars dict and static_buffers dict mapping addresses to type information. Used by StaticVVarRewriter and other passes.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Variable recovery and naming; improves decompilation of static/global variables.

intervention_surfaces.name: Clinic-Level Optimization Scratch Space
intervention_surfaces.description: Clinic and Decompiler maintain optimization_scratch dict that can be used by passes to cache/share data across multiple passes.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Inter-pass communication; allows passes to build on prior pass results.

intervention_surfaces.name: ARCHES and PLATFORMS Attributes
intervention_surfaces.description: Each OptimizationPass declares ARCHES (list of arch names like ['x86', 'x86-64']) and PLATFORMS (like ['linux', 'windows']). Passes filtered by project.arch and project.simos.name.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Which passes run on specific architectures/platforms; allows arch-specific optimizations.

intervention_surfaces.name: STRUCTURING Attribute
intervention_surfaces.description: OptimizationPass.STRUCTURING lists compatible structuring algorithms (e.g., [SAILRStructurer.NAME]). Passes skipped if current structurer not in list.
intervention_surfaces.affects: DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION and AFTER_STRUCTURING passes; ensures passes only run with compatible structuring.

intervention_surfaces.name: Goto Manager State
intervention_surfaces.description: StructuringOptimizationPass maintains _goto_manager (GotoManager) that tracks all gotos in current graph. Passes can inspect/validate goto count changes.
intervention_surfaces.affects: DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass decisions; prevent_new_gotos and goto quality checks.

intervention_surfaces.name: Control Flow Structure Counters
intervention_surfaces.description: StructuringOptimizationPass computes ControlFlowStructureCounter (loop type counts, goto target frequency) before and after optimization to assess relative quality.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Quality validation; _improves_relative_quality() uses these to reject degrading optimizations.

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation Notes
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler and passes can record DecompilationNote objects keyed by name. Notes propagate to codegen and can be used for human refinement.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Annotation of decompilation artifacts; guides LLM/human post-processing.

insights: The decompiler is NOT a pure linear compiler pipeline. Although stages fire in order on first pass (AIL creation -> SSA L0 -> SSA L1 -> region ID -> structuring -> codegen), DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION passes trigger a fixed-point loop where RegionIdentifier is re-run after each graph edit. This is the fundamental feedback loop that distinguishes SAILR (angr's structuring system) from traditional compilers.

The unit of scheduling is NOT a monolithic 'pass' but an (OptimizationPassStage, graph_iteration) pair. The same pass class may execute multiple times with different graph state if structuring/region ID re-runs. This breaks the typical compiler IR assumption that a pass runs once with final data.

Graph topology changes are batched and deferred. RegionIdentifier may create synthetic blocks (for loop successors) without updating the original graph if update_graph=False, forcing later stages (region-simplification passes) to manage both the 'original' graph and the 'semantically-updated' regions. This dual representation is critical to SAILR's iterative de-optimization.

The critical state shared across passes is: (1) reaching_definitions (recomputed after graph edits), (2) block address/index mappings (updated after graph edits), (3) goto_manager state (tracks which edges are gotos, critical for de-optimization decisions), (4) control flow structure counters (loop/goto quality heuristics). These are rebuilt/refreshed after each graph change.

Peephole optimizations are invoked at TWO levels: (1) within block simplification (AFTER_SINGLE_BLOCK, AFTER_*_SIMPLIFICATION stages) as part of AILBlockSimplifier, and (2) post-structuring on sequence nodes. The block-level peephole suite is much larger (~60 optimizations) and operates on AIL expressions/statements; the post-structuring suite is smaller and operates on high-level structured code.

Pass ordering within a stage is significant. Within AFTER_GLOBAL_SIMPLIFICATION, passes are ordered to maximize de-optimization effectiveness: ReturnDuplicatorHigh runs before DeadblockRemover (which removes now-dead blocks created by duplication), and before more structural passes (ITERegionConverter, CrossJumpReverter) that depend on return structure.

The 'preset' system is a user-facing specialization mechanism but does NOT provide orthogonal configuration. Presets are pre-ordered lists of pass classes; there's no declarative 'enable/disable' flag per preset-pass pair. Custom passes must be injected via register_optimization_pass() or custom optimization_passes list.

The constraint system for DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION passes (prevent_new_gotos, must_improve_rel_quality, recover_structure_fails) acts as a 'rewind policy' that is PER-PASS-CLASS, not global. Different passes have different risk tolerance: DuplicationReverter requires relative quality improvement; CrossJumpReverter allows strictly fewer gotos but not equal.

Failure modes are recoverable but silent. If a DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass produces an unstructurable graph, it is silently reverted (if recover_structure_fails=True) or discarded (if False). No exception is raised; the pass simply 'doesn't apply' to that function. This allows graceful degradation on complex binaries.

The decompiler exhibits a form of 'optimistic concurrency control' where later-stage decisions (structuring success/failure, loop quality) retroactively validate earlier-stage decisions (graph edits). If structuring fails, the graph edit is rolled back. This is NOT typical in compilers, which usually fail-fast.

SAILR (SAI Lattice Reasoning) is implemented across multiple passes, not as a monolithic algorithm. DuplicationReverter (ISM - Instruction Stream Merging), CrossJumpReverter (ISC - Instruction Stream Consolidation), ConstPropOptReverter, and LoweredSwitchSimplifier together implement the SAILR doptimization framework. Each is independently schedulable and constrainable, allowing fine-grained control.

The reach-definitions analysis is recomputed AFTER every graph-edit in DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION, but NOT re-run during the fixed-point iteration of a single pass (e.g., DuplicationReverter's internal max_opt_iters loop). This is a trade-off: stale reaching definitions may miss some optimizations within a pass, but fresh definitions are expensive and only computed between passes.

Custom block-by-block simplification can be inserted via the 'cache' parameter to _simplify_block(), allowing external analysis tools to pre-populate reaching definitions and propagator state. This is an underdocumented but powerful extension point for domain-specific optimizations.
